Ayano Shibuya (Japanese: 渋谷彩乃 Shibuya Ayano) is a Japanese voice actress for .

==Biography==
Shibuya was born sometime on May 18, in , . She started work on with , where she voiced 's younger sister Mimo. She is currently affiliated with the talent agency Ken Production.
